pages.text: Energy Pipes form a linked network.$(br)Chain pipes together and connect them to Energy Cells and machines: energy flows along the network to wherever it is needed. Pipes come in four tiers:$(li)Basic: 50,000 / tick$(li)Intermediate: 500,000 / tick$(li)Advanced: 5,000,000 / tick$(li)Ultimate: 50,000,000 / tick$(br)Total network throughput equals the sum of every pipe's rate. Intermediate and above support high-throughput grids such as the Assembled Generator.

Right-click a pipe with the Configurator to cycle its direction mode:$(li)Normal: both ways, judged by device capability$(li)Push: attached devices act only as sinks$(li)Pull: attached devices act only as sources$(br)Sneak (Shift) + right-click to disconnect or reconnect the clicked side. Fine-tune the flow of your network.
